subject: p-values (through permutations) for FDR calculation using q-values

messages.author: 063502b3922d34cd
messages.subject: p-values (through permutations) for FDR calculation using q-values
parts:
Dear Karl,

I’m conducting an QTL study in a mouse intercross.  A challenge is figuring out how to control for multiple testing with many phenotypes (we have n=1841).  One method is using q-values/FDRs based on permutations: to use the package q-value (Storey et al, 2003) I require a list of p-values (instead of LOD-scores) for my R/qtl scanone results for each phenotype.

Is there any way to get a p-value for each marker (as I get for the LOD-scores), instead of the summary function (which I used below), where I just get the highest LOD-score for each chromosome?

for(k in 1:(length(cross0$pheno))) {
out.1=  scanone(cross0, pheno.col=2, method="em", model="normal")
operm.f2<- scanone(cross0, pheno.col=2, method="em", model="normal" , n.perm=1000)
a <- summary (out.1, perms=operm.f2, format="tabByCol", pvalues=TRUE)
write.csv(a,file = paste("C:/Documents and Settings/rQTL_outputFiles_pvalues/pvalues_",names(cross0$pheno[k]),".txt",sep=""))
}

Thanks so much for your help,

Annette
